title: release cutover checklist - daily scratchpad
content:
TL;DR: Cutover for v2026.03.15. Primary goals = deploy runtime 0.9.4 with backported CVE patch, validate latency/throughput, confirm no regression in canary traffic, open post-release monitor for 24h.

Sprint / context notes:
- Release branch: release/v2026.03.15
- Target deploy window: 2026-03-15 17:00 - 18:00 UTC (team overlap with APAC)
- Reason: CVE patch + batching improvement, hotfix for request routing fallback
- Owner: Taylor Nguyen (oncall lead)

Pre-cutover (start 16:00 UTC)
- [ ] Finalize changelog + release notes draft (use PR summary + Confluence notes) -> assign to Samira to tidy by 16:15
- [ ] Verify backports applied to release branch: REL-4321, REL-4330 -> local git log + CI green
- [ ] Run smoke test suite locally (smoke/runtime-smoke.sh) -> expect <5 failures
- [ ] Create release tag: git tag -a v2026.03.15 -m "runtime 0.9.4 - CVE & batching" && git push --tags
- [ ] Confirm infra capacity reservations for Dedicated pool (contact infra on-call)
- [ ] Post pre-cutover note in #releases with ETA and rollback plan summary

Cutover steps (17:00 UTC start)
- [ ] Put automated canaries in place (route 1% traffic to new model variant)
  - command: deploy --env=prod --branch=release/v2026.03.15 --canary=1%
  - confirm canary logs: query grafana panel "canary-errors" (should be near 0)
- [ ] Run canary perf check (run perf/canary-check.sh) -> look for p95 latency within 10% of baseline
- [ ] If canary OK after 10m -> promote to 10% -> monitor 10m -> then 50% -> then 100% staged over 45m
- [ ] During each stage: check error rate, queue length, and CPU/GPU utilization
  - dashboards: runtime/requests, runtime/errors, infra/gpu-util
- [ ] Update #releases with short status updates at each percentage bump

Backports & hotfix list
- REL-4321: CVE patch (applied to release branch) -> test: run unit/security tests
- REL-4330: routing fallback bugfix -> test: reproduce locally via sequence of fallback scenarios
- Note: have cherry-pick SHAs in PR description for quick revert if needed

Rollback plan (if severe issues)
- [ ] Trigger rollback if: error-rate > 2% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency > 2x baseline for 10m
- Rollback command: deploy --env=prod --tag=v2026.03.14 --force
- Notify: @oncall-team, @infra-side, #releases (use template in Confluence)

Communications
- Pre-cutover: post ETA + brief changelog to #releases and email to stakeholder list (ops@redwood.com, product@redwood.com)
- Cutover live updates: short posts at start, after canary, at 50%, at 100%, and after verification
- Post-cutover summary: include perf numbers, incident notes, and list of follow-ups

Monitoring & verification (post-deploy)
- [ ] 0-30m: check canary + service health, look at errors graph and latency p95/p99
- [ ] 30-120m: extended perf validation under steady load (run perf/soak-tests)
- [ ] 24h: open post-release monitoring ticket (REL-4430) and set owner for 24h watch
- Key queries:
  - Errors: sum(rate(errors[1m])) by service
  - Latency: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le))
  - KV cache hit rate: rate(kv_cache_hits[5m]) / rate(kv_cache_requests[5m])

Post-release follow-ups (to triage next week)
- [ ] Confirm telemetry for batching changes (are we seeing expected token-level cost reduction?)
- [ ] Schedule postmortem if any >SEV2 incidents
- [ ] Clean up temporary feature flags and canary routing rules

Notes-to-self / TODOs during day (quick):
- Remember to cc product@ on final summary email (they want usage numbers)
- Keep an eye on Dedicated pool autoscaler logs (last time we saw delayed scale up)
- If infra team asks for runbook, link to Confluence page and offer run-through with them before 16:30

Contacts for the window:
- Taylor Nguyen (owner) - slack: @taylor - phone: +1-555-0123
- Samira Patel (deploy engineer) - slack: @samira
- Jordan Lee (SRE) - slack: @jordan
- Oncall infra rotation - slack: @infra-oncall

Quick scratch commands: 
- smoke: ./smoke/runtime-smoke.sh --env=prod
- canary promote: deploy --promote --service=runtime --percent=10
- revert: deploy --env=prod --tag=v2026.03.14 --force

Unresolved/risks:
- Potential increased p99 when batching kicks in (need to verify tail at higher load)
- Backport tests flaky locally - ensure CI ran full suite and green before promoting

End of day: paste this doc into Confluence under Release v2026.03.15 (finalize notes)

-- Taylor
